title: Pólya--Schur problems and free probability
summary: In this work, we build a bridge between the Pólya--Schur program and Voiculescu's free probability theory. A cornerstone of the former is the Pólya--Benz Theorem, classifying a central family of real-root preserving operators on the space of polynomials, as those given by $f(\partial_z)$ for a Laguerre--Pólya function $f$ and the derivative operator $\partial_{z}$. We prove that any free (additive) infinitely divisible distribution can be attained as the weak limit of root distributions of Appell polynomials $f_n(\partial_z)z^n$ as $n\to\infty$, for a suitably chosen sequence $f_n$ of…
